'''Namarhe''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. Namarhe was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an attempt to capture the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Omicron (transport)|''Omicron'']].<ref name="TCSWE" />
